answer: A concrete Sybil defense in agent economies is stake-bonded registration with slashing. Every agent must lock a minimum bond before it can work, and each pearl of identity is backed by its own bond, so an attacker who wants N fake agents must raise N separate bonds of real capital instead of spreading one stake across an orchard of sock-puppets. The bond is re-checked at every payment and settlement vertex, making fake identities a pure capital cost with no free payoff, while honest agents recover their stake when they exit.
